messages:
sam: :rotating_light: Canary v2 rollout showing spike in 5xx on eu-prod canaries, started ~4450012300. Not large but trending quickly.
maria: seeing the same in the dashboard — https://redwood.app/obs/dashboards/canary-eu
maria: 5xx from assemble-service, error class = downstream-timeout
incident-bot: AUTOMATED_ALERT: Canary anomaly detected (canary_id=canary-eu-2026-03-17, severity=warning)
tomh: did the automated rollback kick in?
deploy-bot: AUTO-ROLLBACK_TRIGGERED: rollback job #rb-4450012345 started for canary v2 -> initiating traffic drain
sam: auto-rollback started but logs show some hosts not draining, probly stuck connection count. Need manual drain on those nodes.
irene: I can take node eviction. Which ASG/instance IDs? dashboard shows node tags: eu-canary-32a, eu-canary-32b
maria: eu-canary-32b has high ESTABLISHED sockets. suspect long-poll clients.
sam: tomh please run the quick-drain playbook, then we can re-evaluate. playbook link: https://redwood.app/runbooks/canary-drain
tomh: running drain now: ``kubectl cordon eu-canary-32b && kubectl drain eu-canary-32b --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data``
tomh: drain started, may take ~45s
maria: customer impact: a small fraction of requests (0.8%) are getting 503s while connections shift. No major customer incidents reported yet.
sam: marking incident page. @irene you own verification after drain completes. I'll keep pager warm.
irene: will run smoke tests once drain finishes: ``curl -sS -f https://api.eu.redwood.example/health || echo FAIL``
incident-bot: PAGE: oncall sam assigned (pager duty)
sam: if drain doesn't finish in 2m, manual kill-switch: flip feature flag `canary_v2` to off in Flags UI.
maria: flag is ready, granted perms to oncall. UI: https://flags.redwood.app/flags/canary_v2
deploy-bot: rollback job reports 12/14 replicas terminated, 2 remaining (eu-canary-32b, eu-canary-31f)
tomh: eu-canary-31f still processing connections, force-terminating now: ``pkill -f longpoll || true``
tomh: force kill done, restarting kube-proxy to clear connections: ``systemctl restart kube-proxy``
irene: running smoke check now.
irene: smoke checks: auth flow OK, embeddings OK, quick generation test returns 200. Latency back to baseline.
maria: monitoring looks stable. 5xx rate down to baseline in the last 60s.
sam: good. keep an eye for regressions for the next 15m. leave rollback job in logs for audit: rb-4450012345
maria: note for postmortem: automate graceful-drain fallback for long-poll connections — add to runbook.
tomh: agreed. will open a PR to add connection-drain hook to the rollout controller.
incident-bot: INCIDENT_RESOLVED: canary rollback completed (rb-4450012345). Please confirm final status.
sam: confirming resolved. handing off to day SRE for follow-up and postmortem: @maria
maria: I'll own the postmortem and customer impact notification. Drafting summary now.
sam: thanks. closing pager. :white_check_mark:
